# AeroGuard Flight Training Center

> > AeroGuard is a comprehensive flight training school offering FAA-certified pilot pathways, university degree programs, and airline career preparation with partnerships including SkyWest Airlines.

AeroGuard Flight Training Center specializes in zero-to-airline commercial pilot training through multiple pathways including their flagship Pilot Pathway Program, university partnerships with Arizona State University and Purdue University, and international student programs. The school emphasizes career progression with guaranteed interview programs and mentorship opportunities.

## Key Topics

- FAA Certifications
- Commercial Pilot License
- Pilot Pathway Program
- SkyWest Airlines Partnership
- Flight Training
- Private Pilot License
- Instrument Rating
- Airline Career Pathway
- Flight School Financing
- International Students
- Arizona State University
- Purdue University
- Certified Flight Instructor
- ATP (Airline Transport Pilot)
- Guaranteed Interviews

## Core Programs & Overview

- [AeroGuard Flight Training Center](https://www.flyaeroguard.com): AeroGuard Flight Training Center homepage for commercial pilot training
- [Pilot Training Programs](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs): Overview of AeroGuard's three pilot training programs and pathways
- [Pilot Pathway Program](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway): AeroGuard's flagship Pilot Pathway Program for zero-to-airline training
- [University Flight Training Programs](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/university-flight-training-programs): University partnerships with ASU and Purdue for degree programs
- [International Flight Training Programs](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/international): International pilot training program for non-US student cadets

## SkyWest Cadet Program & Career Pathway

- [SkyWest Cadet Program](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway/skywest-cadet): SkyWest Cadet Program with guaranteed interviews and mentorship
- [Being a SkyWest Cadet](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway/skywest-cadet/being-a-skywest-cadet): Details on SkyWest Cadet benefits, seniority, and mentorship program
- [Pilot Career Path](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway/skywest-cadet/your-career-track): Career progression path through SkyWest to major airlines

## Pilot Pathway Curriculum & Admissions

- [Flight School Courses](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway/courses): Curriculum overview with 7 FAA certifications and ratings taught
- [Flight School Admission Requirements](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway/requirements): Admission requirements including medical certificate for cadets
- [Admissions & Enrollment](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway/admissions): Four-step enrollment process and admissions requirements

## Tuition & Financing

- [Flight School Tuition & Costs](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway/tuition): Tuition pricing, costs, and financing options for flight training
- [Flight School Financing Options](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/pilot-pathway/financing): Flight school financing options and payment plans available

## University Partnership Programs

- [Arizona State University Flight Program](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/university-flight-training-programs/arizona-state-university): ASU B.S. Aeronautical Management Technology with flight training
- [AeroGuard & ASU Admissions](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/asu-admissions): Enrollment and admissions process for ASU Professional Flight degree
- [Purdue University Flight Training](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/university-flight-training-programs/purdue-university): Purdue University Global B.S. Professional Flight with training

## International Student Programs

- [International Student Admissions](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/international/admissions): International student admissions with visa and TSA requirements
- [Canada Pilot Program](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/international/canada-pilot-program): Commercial pilot training in USA for Canadian students
- [Cambodia Pilot Program](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/international/cambodia-pilot-program): Commercial pilot training for international students from Cambodia
- [Korea Pilot Program](https://www.flyaeroguard.com/programs/international/korea-pilot-program): Commercial pilot training for international students from Korea
